class.name: CgameVRAMBudget
class.brief_description: Watches video memory and reports sustained pressure against a per-quality budget.
class.description: [CgameVRAMBudget] helps an automatic quality system step down before the driver starts paging or evicting memory, which causes multi-second hitches on 8 GB machines. Each quality level [code]0..3[/code] has a budget of 1536, 2560, 4096 and 6144 MiB. Feed [method sample] once per frame with [method used_bytes]. It returns [code]true[/code] once usage has stayed above 92% of the current level's budget for 2 seconds and the level can still be lowered. Use [method upgrade_allowed] to block quality upgrades unless usage is below 75% of the next level's budget.

method.name: budget_bytes
method.description: Returns the memory budget of [param level] (clamped to [code]0..3[/code]) in bytes.

method.name: get_pressure_seconds
method.description: Returns the number of seconds the memory has currently stayed above the pressure line.

method.name: sample
method.description: Adds [param delta] seconds to the pressure timer when [param used] bytes exceed 92% of the budget of [param level], and resets it otherwise. Returns [code]true[/code] (and resets the timer) once pressure has lasted 2 seconds and [param level] is above [code]0[/code]. Non-finite or non-positive memory readings and frame durations, as well as frame durations above 0.2 seconds, are ignored without changing accumulated pressure.

method.name: upgrade_allowed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param used] is finite, positive and at most 75% of the budget of the next level. Missing residency telemetry does not constitute evidence that an upgrade is safe.

method.name: used_bytes
method.description: Returns the video memory currently used according to [method RenderingServer.get_rendering_info], in bytes.
